metric_defs.coverage: n_called / n (fraction of amplicons that got a call); n is the full scored-amplicon population and is identical across self_modes at domain=all/tier=all, so an exclude-self abstention is a no-call, never a removed sample
metric_defs.correct: n_correct / n_called -- accuracy CONDITIONAL on a call. Under self-exclusion the called-denominator shrinks toward easy cases, so this OVERSTATES novel-organism generalization; read it with coverage, or use correct_population
metric_defs.correct_population: n_correct / n -- accuracy over the FULL population (a no-call/abstention counts as not-correct); == correct * coverage; the honest generalization number
